title: Atlas Zettel Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a Zettel (zettel/*.md) — the knowledge entity of the Atlas Werkbank (issue #180): Lektuere, Betreuergespraech, Methodik, Entscheidung, Fluechtiges, Rueckblick. Deliberately NOT called 'Notiz' — Notizen are the core's per-paper notes. P5: the title is the only required field. The Markdown body may carry '[[id]]' Verweise to any Atlas entity; the indexer reads them into the edge table, and the reverse direction is the Rueckverweis of the target's detail page. ID = 'YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>' of the title, unique by suffix, immutable and equal to the filename.

type.description: Kind of knowledge this Zettel holds.

date.description: Day the Zettel belongs to; defaults to the day it was created.

refs.description: Literature as Paper cite keys → join to the LocalBib library. Hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired.

promoted_to.description: Id of the Idea this Zettel was developed into. Set by the promote action; the Zettel file stays (P1).
